title: 2025 Family Day
systemPrompt: Please generate a script for a children book on the topic provided by the user. Each page (=beat) must have an image prompt appropriate for the text. IMPORTANT: All imagePrompt fields must be written in English for optimal image generation, even if the story text is in Japanese. Keep each imagePrompt focused on a single scene or moment - avoid describing multiple scenes in one prompt. Create detailed imagePrompts (80-120 words) with consistent character descriptions for accuracy and consistency. CRITICAL: Always describe main characters consistently throughout the story (e.g., if a character is 'a small round alien creature with big eyes' in the first scene, maintain this exact description in all subsequent scenes). Include important visual details like character appearance, setting, mood, and atmosphere. The system will automatically simplify prompts if needed, so prioritize accuracy and consistency over brevity.

imageParams.style: A hand-drawn style illustration with a warm, nostalgic atmosphere. The background is rich with natural scenery—lush forests, cloudy skies, and traditional Japanese architecture. Characters have expressive eyes, soft facial features, and are portrayed with gentle lighting and subtle shading. The color palette is muted yet vivid, using earthy tones and watercolor-like textures. The overall scene feels magical and peaceful, with a sense of quiet wonder and emotional depth, reminiscent of classic 1980s and 1990s Japanese animation.
